summary: Dispatches a vtable method on the object (function pointer loaded from byte offset 0x40, passed this and the flag stored at this[56] / byte offset 0xE0), then calls UIWindowTypeDetection(this). Always returns 0. Part of a UI component update path invoked by several 0046xxxx dispatch wrappers.

operations.description: Indirect vtable dispatch: call the method pointer read from byte offset 0x40, passing this (vtable root at offset 0x0) and the flag value at this[56] (byte offset 0xE0) as its argument.
Invoke UIWindowTypeDetection(this) to detect or update UI window type classification.

unresolved: Which virtual method lives at vtable entry offset 0x40 and what the this[56] flag controls are unresolved.
Purpose of UIWindowTypeDetection beyond classification is unproven.
